rows.grounds: compound of catūr (four), varga (aims), and prada (giving); accusative singular neuter agreeing with mantra
middle imperative second person singular from root śru
vocative compound addressing the goddess as beloved of Hara

items.question: What fourfold aims does this mantra bestow upon the devotee?
premises: The mantra is described as giving
The four aims are named as its gift
The goddess is asked to listen
items.inference: The verse presents the mantra as bestowing the four aims upon the devotee.
uncertainties: The exact four aims are not enumerated in this verse
items.plain_english: O goddess, beloved of Hara, listen: this mantra bestows the four aims.
